name: builtin-speech-to-text
description: Speech-to-Text with auto backend detection (Hailo NPU / CUDA / ROCm GPU / CPU)

backend.label: Backend
backend.description: Inference backend. 'auto' detects the best available.

model_size.label: Model Size
model_size.description: Whisper model size. Larger = more accurate but slower.

default_language.label: Default Language
default_language.description: Default language code for transcription (e.g. ja, en)

stream_chunk_min_sec.label: Stream Min Chunk (sec)
stream_chunk_min_sec.description: Minimum audio chunk duration before splitting at silence

stream_chunk_max_sec.label: Stream Max Chunk (sec)
stream_chunk_max_sec.description: Maximum audio chunk duration (force-split if no silence)

stream_silence_threshold.label: Stream Silence Threshold
stream_silence_threshold.description: RMS threshold for silence detection in stream mode

stream_silence_ms.label: Stream Silence Duration (ms)
stream_silence_ms.description: Minimum silence duration to trigger chunk split

live_interval_sec.label: Live Interval (sec)
live_interval_sec.description: Interval between transcription runs in live streaming mode
